svg.title: dev-loop — the full development loop
svg.desc: Flowchart of the full dev-loop: nine phases from framing through implementation, tests and shipping; a nine-lane parallel review round with model tiers; a tree-integrity check with recovery; and the blocked, escalate, and loop-back-to-Phase-3 exits that bound it.
